title: Event and Environmental Design Across SaaS
summary: A cross-company view of event identities, conference environments, presentations, and supporting digital campaigns.
overview: Across AppOmni, Apollo GraphQL, TripActions, MongoDB, and DocuSign, I directed event and environmental work spanning booths, stages, venue graphics, presentations, wayfinding, digital signage, and campaign support.

projectBrief.context: The work spans developer conferences, customer programs, product launches, and executive events across several technology companies.
projectBrief.challenge: Each program had different audiences, venues, and production requirements, but every experience needed a clear idea that could hold together across physical and digital formats.
projectBrief.contribution: I led creative direction and hands-on design across event identities, booths, stages, presentations, signage, wayfinding, digital displays, and supporting campaigns.
projectBrief.approach: I built scalable visual systems, worked with vendors and production partners, and adapted each concept to the practical needs of the venue and audience.
projectBrief.outcome: The portfolio shows a repeatable event practice across five companies, covering concept development, production, presentation design, and campaign follow-through.
